data.long_meaning: Faahima is a name derived from the Arabic word 'faahima', which means 'knowledgeable' or 'wise'. This name is deeply rooted in the Islamic tradition, symbolizing the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom as essential virtues. The name Faahima carries the meaning “Knowledgeable, Wise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Faahima usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledgeable, wise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
